missing_points: Default parameters are reset by setting P053 (Reset Defaults) to value '2' 'Factory Reset'
After factory reset, all user parameters return to original defaults from the factory
The drive must be power-cycled to apply the factory reset completely
GS10 keypad will require re-entry of basic parameters after factory reset (Speed Reference, Control Source, etc.)
wrong_if_present: Confuses parameter P053 with P051 or P052 (which are backfill or recovery functions)
correctness.note: The answer identifies the wrong control parameter (P00.02 instead of P053) and gives reset values not supported by the rubric.

grounding.note: The citation supports 50/60 Hz default reset options and retention of P13.01~P13.50, but does not support P00.02 or the stated values 9/10.

actionability.note: It gives a concrete parameter/value pair, but it is not the correct one per the rubric and omits the required power-cycle and re-entry implications.

uncertainty.note: Low confidence in correctness because the cited evidence directly conflicts with the answer's parameter naming and values.
